titles.title: Pedernal – From the Ranch II

description: A softly shaded, pale orange form fills much of the canvas, save for an oval-shaped hole at its center. Through the hole, the blue silhouette of Pedernal appears against a pale blue and white sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
